changes.before: City of Renton data-center moratorium, approved 2026-08-17 according to Renton Reporter; the city’s August 17 agenda identifies the proposed instrument as Ordinance No. 6200 under RCW 36.70A.390.
changes.after: Renton City Council minutes record adoption of Ordinance No. 6200 on 2026-08-17 by roll call, all ayes, after advancement to second and final reading. The ordinance title describes a large-data-center moratorium, declares an emergency and states an immediate effective date. The city’s August 17 agenda identifies RCW 36.70A.390; the full signed ordinance and its operative provisions remain to be verified.

changes.before: Renton Reporter reported that the council unanimously approved a moratorium on applications and permits for the siting, establishment, or expansion of large data centers on 2026-08-17 for up to one year. The city’s October 5 agenda listed a hearing on the moratorium; the retained agenda does not establish its outcome. Previously attributed exceptions for pre-effective-date applications and maintenance or repair without expansion remain reported. [VERIFY: enacted ordinance, effective anchor, hearing outcome, later action and current force.]
changes.after: The August 17, 2026 council minutes record adoption of Ordinance No. 6200 by roll call, all ayes. The hearing entry’s opening sentence also refers to CDBG allocations. Previously attributed exceptions for pre-effective-date applications and maintenance or repair without expansion remain reported.
